conflict.competency_code_taken: A competency with that code already exists in this framework.
conflict.cycle_code_taken: A cycle with that code already exists.

notice.actionsAreUsability: These are the actions this state permits. The server decides independently and refuses anything it does not allow.
notice.aggregateWithheld: Below the configured minimum the panel aggregate is withheld. That withholds a number; it does not make the responses anonymous.
notice.calibrationKept: Calibration records a new rating beside the original. It never replaces the calculated score.
notice.conflict: Somebody else changed this while you were reading it. Reload before acting; nothing has been overwritten.
notice.exactScore: Scores are whole hundredths and measurements are exact. Nothing on this screen is recalculated.
notice.managerCounted: The assessment the calculated score is derived from.
notice.noDocumentBytes: A document reference only. There is no upload, download or link — no storage adapter exists.
notice.noNotifications: Notification intent is recorded. Nothing in this product delivers it.
notice.noOkr: Objectives and key results have tables but no application contract, so there is nothing to show.
notice.noSchedule: Nothing opens or closes on a schedule. A cycle moves because somebody moved it.
notice.notAnonymous: Reviewer identity is confidential, not anonymous. Every response records who wrote it.
notice.peerNotCounted: Recorded and readable. It does not contribute to the calculated score.
notice.readTeamUnavailable: A manager's own queue is unavailable: this product cannot yet resolve a signed-in person to their employment, so nothing here can prove a caller is the manager they name.
notice.selfNotCounted: Recorded and readable. It does not contribute to the calculated score.
notice.unauthenticated: Not signed in, or this workspace is not permitted for you. The server decides; this screen only reports what it was told.
notice.weightsTotal: Component weights are basis points and must total 10,000 — one whole.
notice.withheld: Withheld — you hold the permission to see that this exists, but not to read it.

rejection.assessment-already-submitted: This assessment has been submitted and can no longer be changed.
rejection.assessment-has-no-items: An assessment cannot be submitted without at least one goal or competency.
rejection.assessment-item-excluded-carries-score: A line that has been excluded cannot also carry a score.
rejection.assessment-item-exclusion-unknown: That is not a recognised reason for excluding a line.
rejection.assessment-item-score-not-whole: A score must be a whole number of hundredths.
rejection.assessment-item-score-out-of-range: That score is outside the rating scale.
rejection.assessment-item-subject-ambiguous: A line assesses a goal or a competency, not both.
rejection.assessment-item-subject-missing: This line does not say what it assesses.
rejection.assessment-item-weight-out-of-range: A weight must be between 0 and 10,000 basis points.
rejection.assessment-kind-unknown: That is not a recognised kind of assessment.
rejection.calibration-code-invalid: A calibration session code may contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
rejection.calibration-conclusion-not-human: A calibration session is concluded by a named person.
rejection.calibration-decision-already-recorded: This session has already decided on that review.

rejection.calibration-decision-not-human: A calibration decision is made by a named person.
rejection.calibration-not-in-session: Decisions can only be recorded while the session is in progress.
rejection.calibration-review-not-in-cycle: That review belongs to a different cycle.
rejection.calibration-score-not-whole: A calibrated score must be a whole number of hundredths.
rejection.calibration-score-out-of-range: A calibrated score must fall within the rating scale.
rejection.calibration-self-refused: Nobody may calibrate their own review.
rejection.calibration-transition-refused: A calibration session cannot move to that state from here.
rejection.calibration-use-conclude-command: Use the conclude action, which records who concluded the session.
rejection.competency-category-unknown: That is not a recognised competency category.
rejection.competency-code-invalid: A competency code may contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

rejection.competency-weight-out-of-range: A weight must be between 0 and 10,000 basis points.
rejection.competency-weight-required: This framework is weighted, so every competency needs a weight.
rejection.cycle-cancellation-needs-reason: Cancelling a cycle needs a reason.
rejection.cycle-closure-not-human: A cycle is closed by a named person.
rejection.cycle-code-invalid: A cycle code may contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
rejection.cycle-due-before-period: A due date cannot fall before the period it belongs to.
rejection.cycle-has-incomplete-reviews: This cycle still has reviews nobody has completed.
rejection.cycle-kind-unknown: That is not a recognised kind of cycle.
rejection.cycle-not-enrolling: This cycle is no longer taking participants.
rejection.cycle-period-inverted: A cycle cannot end before it begins.
rejection.cycle-template-retired: That review template has been retired.
rejection.cycle-transition-refused: A cycle cannot move to that state from here.
rejection.cycle-use-specific-command: Use the close or cancel action, which records who acted and why.

rejection.evidence-document-unknown: That evidence document could not be found.
rejection.feedback-author-unknown: The author’s employment could not be confirmed.
rejection.feedback-body-empty: Feedback needs something written in it.
rejection.feedback-body-too-long: Feedback is longer than the maximum allowed.
rejection.feedback-kind-unknown: That is not a recognised kind of feedback.
rejection.feedback-subject-unknown: The subject’s employment could not be confirmed.
rejection.feedback-visibility-unknown: That is not a recognised visibility.
rejection.goal-already-closed: This goal has been closed and can no longer be changed.
rejection.goal-approval-not-human: A goal is approved by a named person.
rejection.goal-cancelled-carries-no-score: A cancelled goal carries no score.
rejection.goal-category-code-invalid: A goal category code may contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
rejection.goal-closure-needs-score: Closing a goal as achieved or missed needs a score.
rejection.goal-employment-inactive: That employment is no longer active.
rejection.goal-employment-unknown: That employment could not be confirmed.
rejection.goal-measurement-unknown: That is not a recognised way of measuring a goal.
rejection.goal-not-in-progress: Progress can only be recorded against a goal that is under way.
rejection.goal-owner-mismatch: This goal’s owner does not match its scope.
rejection.goal-parent-is-itself: A goal cannot be its own parent.
rejection.goal-period-inverted: A goal cannot be due before it starts.

rejection.goal-scope-unknown: That is not a recognised goal scope.

rejection.goal-transition-refused: A goal cannot move to that state from here.

rejection.goal-weight-frozen-while-active: A goal’s weight cannot change once it is under way.
rejection.goal-weight-out-of-range: A weight must be between 0 and 10,000 basis points.
rejection.placement-already-recorded: This review already has a talent placement.
rejection.placement-band-out-of-range: A talent band must be 1, 2 or 3.
rejection.placement-not-human: A talent placement is recorded by a named person.

rejection.rating-scale-code-invalid: A rating scale code may contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

withheld.calibrationConcluded: A concluded calibration session takes no further decisions.
withheld.cycleClosed: A closed cycle does not reopen. Its reviews are completed and immutable.
withheld.notCalibrated: No calibration decision has been recorded.
withheld.notScored: The review has not been scored yet.
withheld.reviewArchived: An archived review is terminal and read-only.
withheld.reviewCompleted: A completed review is immutable. Its rating is what it said on the day.
